tools.name: market_rates
tools.description: Median wholesale price per kg, litre or each, taken only from verified suppliers' own listings, and only where three or more verified suppliers list the product. Returns an empty list when no product has enough verified suppliers yet; then use search_prices.

tools.name: find_suppliers
tools.description: Suppliers listed on Suppliers Net, by what they sell and where. Returns name, categories, state, a profile link, and a status: verified (claimed and ABN matched), checked, claimed, or listed (from public records). No phone numbers or email addresses are returned; the profile page says how to contact
